title: UI: Actions panel (frame script code editor)
description: Add an Actions panel to the authoring UI. When a frame is selected, show its script in a code editor panel. Use a simple <textarea> or a basic Monaco/CodeMirror-lite editor. Changes update frame.script via pushDoc. Wire a toggle button (F9 or toolbar) to show/hide the panel. The panel should appear at the bottom of the UI, collapsible.
